jsPDF 2.5.1 (`jspdf.umd.min.js`) and jspdf-autotable 3.8.2 (`jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js`), copied
unmodified from their npm packages. Served from this origin because nginx.conf's CSP
(`script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'`) blocks the cdn.jsdelivr.net copies — used by ecom.html's
order PDF / packing list / bulk export.
